#!/usr/bin/env python3
# osm_index_method_build.py -- build script of the OpenStreetMap-derived address index "osm_num_rue v1 (2026-10-09)",
# published as part of the ODbL 4.6(b) method (lot OSM-CONFORMITE-TEST, 12/10). Standalone: Python 3 stdlib + osmium.
# It imports ONLY osm_normalization.py, the normalization rules shipped next to it in the same method file.
#
# What it does to the OpenStreetMap extract (the whole list of alterations):
#   1. keeps the OSM objects (nodes, ways, relations) tagged addr:housenumber   (osmium tags-filter)
#   2. attaches node coordinates to those ways (osmium add-locations-to-ways) and the member geometry of those
#      relations (osmium getid -r)
#   3. stores them in one SQLite table osm(num, rue, oid, ligne, geom, complet), where
#        num   = normalized addr:housenumber            (osm_normalization.norm)
#        rue   = normalized addr:street                 (osm_normalization.norm_street, through osm_returned)
#        oid   = OSM object id (n123 / w123 / r123), ligne = the object in OPL form, geom = its geometry in OPL,
#        complet = 1 if every node of the geometry was found in the extract
#   4. creates the index cle_num_rue on (num, rue).
# No other data is read: no address list, no third-party database. No row is dropped (an empty rue is a value).
#
# Usage: osm_index_method_build.py EXTRACT.osm.pbf OUTPUT_DIR [EXPECTED_SHA256]
# Row logic below is the one used to build the index on 2026-10-09; only machine-specific paths and an internal
# fingerprint step were left out.
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import time

import osm_normalization as P

NAME = "osm_num_rue.sqlite"
BUILD_RULE_VERSION = "osm_num_rue v1 (2026-10-09)"
USAGE = "usage public sous ODbL, methode offerte (4.6 b)"
ATTRIBUTION = "© OpenStreetMap contributors — ODbL 1.0"
LICENCE_URL = "https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright"


def osm_cle(line):
    # access key of the address matcher: normalized addr:housenumber read in the OPL line
    i = line.find("addr:housenumber=")
    j, k = line.find(",", i), line.find(" ", i)
    k = k if k > 0 else len(line.rstrip("\n"))
    return P.norm(P.opl_unesc(line[i + 17: j if 0 < j < k else k]))


def osm_rue(line):
    # normalized street: opl_parse then osm_returned
    return P.osm_returned(P.opl_parse(line)[2])["street"]


def way_geometry(addr_line, located_line, counts):
    """(geometry OPL, complet) of a way from its line with node locations (osmium add-locations-to-ways)."""
    a, b = addr_line[:addr_line.find(" ")], located_line[:located_line.find(" ")]
    if a != b:
        raise SystemExit("STOP: ways out of step")
    i = located_line.find(" N")
    refs = located_line[i + 2:].split(" ")[0].rstrip("\n").split(",") if i > 0 else []
    g, missing = [], False
    for r in refs:
        if not r:
            continue
        xi, yi = r.find("x"), r.find("y")
        counts["refs_w"] += 1
        nid, x, y = r[1:xi], r[xi + 1:yi], r[yi + 1:]
        if not x or not y:
            counts["refs_w_sans_coord"] += 1
            missing = True
            continue
        g.append("n%s x%s y%s\n" % (nid, x, y))
    counts["chemins_incomplets"] += missing
    return "".join(g), 0 if missing else 1


def rows(addr_lines, located_ways, counts, relations):
    """One row per object carrying addr:housenumber, in stream order. Relations get their geometry later."""
    for line in addr_lines:
        t_ = line[0]
        counts[t_] += 1
        oid = line[:line.find(" ")]
        rue = osm_rue(line)
        counts["rue_vide"] += rue == ""
        if t_ == "w":
            yield (osm_cle(line), rue, oid, line) + way_geometry(line, next(located_ways), counts)
        else:
            if t_ == "r":
                relations.append(oid)
            yield osm_cle(line), rue, oid, line, None, 1 if t_ == "n" else None


def relation_complete(rid, rels_lines, nodes, ways, seen):
    if rid in seen:
        return True
    seen.add(rid)
    rl = rels_lines.get(rid)
    if rl is None:
        return False
    for m, x in P.opl_parse(rl)[6]:
        if m == "n" and x not in nodes:
            return False
        if m == "w" and (x not in ways or any(n not in nodes for n in P.opl_parse(ways[x])[5])):
            return False
        if m == "r" and not relation_complete(x, rels_lines, nodes, ways, seen):
            return False
    return True


def main(pbf, out, expected_sha=None):
    sha = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(pbf, "rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 24), b""):
            sha.update(b)
    if expected_sha and sha.hexdigest() != expected_sha:
        raise SystemExit("STOP: extract sha256 %s != expected %s" % (sha.hexdigest(), expected_sha))
    path = os.path.join(out, NAME)
    if os.path.exists(path):
        raise SystemExit("STOP: %s already exists (never overwritten)" % path)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(out, "tmp-tri"), exist_ok=True)
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    for p in ("journal_mode=OFF", "synchronous=OFF", "temp_store=FILE", "cache_size=-2000000", "page_size=4096"):
        db.execute("pragma " + p)
    db.execute("create table osm(num text, rue text, oid text, ligne text, geom text, complet integer)")
    loc_cmd = "osmium tags-filter '%s' w/addr:housenumber -f pbf -o - | osmium add-locations-to-ways -F pbf - " \
              "--ignore-missing-nodes -f opl,add_metadata=false -o -" % pbf
    loc = subprocess.Popen(["/bin/sh", "-c", loc_cmd], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1 << 20)
    located = (l for l in loc.stdout if l[0] == "w")
    counts = {"n": 0, "w": 0, "r": 0, "refs_w": 0, "refs_w_sans_coord": 0, "chemins_incomplets": 0,
              "relations_incompletes": 0, "rue_vide": 0}
    rel = []
    db.executemany("insert into osm values (?,?,?,?,?,?)", rows(P.osm_addr_lines(pbf), located, counts, rel))
    db.commit()
    if sum(1 for _ in located):
        raise SystemExit("STOP: located ways without counterpart")
    counts["rc_localisation"] = loc.wait()          # recorded, as in the 2026-10-09 build (rc 0 there)

    idf = os.path.join(out, "tmp-tri", "relations_ids.txt")
    open(idf, "w").write("\n".join(rel) + "\n")
    p = subprocess.Popen(["osmium", "getid", "-r", "-i", idf, "-f", "opl,add_metadata=false", "-o", "-", pbf],
                         stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1 << 20)
    nodes, ways, rels_lines = {}, {}, {}
    for l in p.stdout:
        oid = int(l[1:l.find(" ")])
        (nodes if l[0] == "n" else ways if l[0] == "w" else rels_lines)[oid] = l
    counts["rc_getid_relations"] = p.wait()        # recorded (osmium returns 1 when a member is missing)
    os.remove(idf)
    up = []
    for r in rel:
        rl = rels_lines.get(int(r[1:]))
        mem = P.opl_parse(rl)[6] if rl else []
        wl = [ways[w] for m, w in mem if m == "w" and w in ways]
        ns = dict.fromkeys(n for w in wl for n in P.opl_parse(w)[5])
        ok = relation_complete(int(r[1:]), rels_lines, nodes, ways, set())
        counts["relations_incompletes"] += not ok
        up.append(("".join(wl) + "".join(nodes[n] for n in ns if n in nodes), 1 if ok else 0))
    fin = db.execute("select rowid, oid from osm where rowid > (select max(rowid) from osm) - ? order by rowid",
                     (len(rel),)).fetchall()
    if [o for _, o in fin] != rel:
        raise SystemExit("STOP: relations not at the end of the stream")
    db.executemany("update osm set geom = ?, complet = ? where rowid = ?",
                   [(g, ok, rid) for (g, ok), (rid, _) in zip(up, fin)])
    db.commit()
    db.execute("create index cle_num_rue on osm(num, rue)")
    meta = {"statut": "OSM_ODBL_DERIVED", "usage_autorise": USAGE, "attribution": ATTRIBUTION,
            "licence_url": LICENCE_URL, "osm_source_file": os.path.basename(pbf), "osm_source_sha256": sha.hexdigest(),
            "build_rule_version": BUILD_RULE_VERSION, "index_key": "(num, rue)",
            "created_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())}
    db.execute("create table metadonnees(cle text primary key, valeur text)")
    db.executemany("insert into metadonnees values (?,?)", sorted(meta.items()))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    print(json.dumps(counts, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) not in (3, 4):
        raise SystemExit("usage: osm_index_method_build.py EXTRACT.osm.pbf OUTPUT_DIR [EXPECTED_SHA256]")
    main(*sys.argv[1:])
